kjv: hang them (the chiefs) up before the LORD against the sun
mine: impale them (the chiefs) before Yahweh in the sun
note: Hebrew hoqa' (cf. 2 Sam 21:6) denotes a form of public execution and exposure, probably impaling or dismembering; "hang" suggests a noose.
Hebrew tsaror means to be hostile to, attack; "vex" in 1611 meant harass or afflict, now it reads as merely "annoy".
